comments.author: @TyMalice
comments.text: I’ve been living in Texas with family for over two years now. Only job I’ve been able to find and keep here in Texas is Walmart. The pay is okay, but still not enough for me to live out on my own yet. Anytime I search for better work online, it either pays less, is two hours away, or I lack the experience needed for it. I hate this job market so much.
